FROM THE FIRST IDEA

Our journey

From a student competition to technology and creative projects. Completed milestones, competition results, and media coverage.

01 — IDEA02 — TRIAL03 — LEAP ↗
01

January 2026

Team Trampolin begins

Three students form a team for DemocraTICon, win the first round in Prague, and advance to the national final.

02

April 9–10, 2026

3rd place in Olomouc

Hugo and Dan represent the team at the DemocraTICon national final and bring home third place.

03

May–September 2026

Client work and creative projects

Three projects for a RE/MAX agent produce six videos. Hugo also develops DOOM Bounce and website studies.

04

September 2026

The AI radio MVP

An experiment in generated music for work, without repeating the same tracks.

05

October 10–11, 2026

2nd place at EVOHACKS

Hugo’s ClearMessage prototype wins second place in an online student hackathon focused on AI for Automation.

03

Completed competitions

2nd place

EVOHACKS 2026

An online hackathon for high school students held on October 10–11, with the theme AI for Automation. Hugo’s ClearMessage prototype received second place.

Official result ↗
3rd place

DemocraTICon 2026

A student competition in media literacy, cybersecurity, and AI. Hugo, Dan, and Vojta won the Prague first round. Hugo and Dan represented the team at the national final in Olomouc, where the team placed third.
